occupations.text: front desk clerk at the hotel
college student on a short break
retired teacher on a day trip
nurse spending a day off out of town

traits.name: Curious
traits.description: Asks about new things and likes hearing how other people do them.

traits.name: Imaginative
traits.description: Thinks up new ideas out loud and enjoys trying a different way.

traits.name: Down-to-earth
traits.description: Prefers the familiar and practical over anything new.

traits.name: Traditional
traits.description: Likes things done the way they have always been done.

traits.name: Organized
traits.description: Keeps things in order and follows through on what they say.

traits.name: Careful
traits.description: Checks the details before acting and dislikes mistakes.

traits.name: Easygoing
traits.description: Goes with the flow and does not sweat the small stuff.

traits.name: Spontaneous
traits.description: Decides on the spot and changes plans easily.

traits.name: Outgoing
traits.description: Enjoys meeting people and starts conversations easily.

traits.name: Lively
traits.description: Talks with energy and brightens up the room.

traits.name: Reserved
traits.description: Keeps to themselves and speaks when there is something to say.

traits.name: Quiet
traits.description: Prefers listening to talking.

traits.name: Kind
traits.description: Notices when someone needs help and offers it.

traits.name: Patient
traits.description: Stays gentle with people who are slow or unsure.

traits.name: Blunt
traits.description: Says what they think without softening it.

traits.name: Guarded
traits.description: Does not trust easily and keeps new people at a distance.

traits.name: Sensitive
traits.description: Feels small slights strongly and shows when something bothers them.

traits.name: Worrier
traits.description: Thinks about what could go wrong before it happens.

traits.name: Calm
traits.description: Stays steady when things get busy or tense.

traits.name: Resilient
traits.description: Bounces back quickly from a bad moment.

values.text: Freedom to do things their own way
Honesty, even when it is awkward

motivations.text: Get better at what they do
Finish the day without a single mistake
Have a little fun before the day is over
See places they have never seen
Try something they have never tried
motivations.ko: 해 본 적 없는 것 해 보기

motivations.text: Find a quiet moment for themselves
Take care of their own business first
Save up for a place of their own someday
motivations.ko: 언젠가 자기 가게를 열 돈 모으기

firstMeeting.high: Greets new people warmly and starts small talk right away.
firstMeeting.middle: Greets new people politely and lets the talk go where it goes.
firstMeeting.low: Greets new people politely but keeps it short until they know them.

familiarityExpression.high: Remembers small things about people they have met and asks about them.
familiarityExpression.middle: Becomes a little more relaxed and chatty with people they have met before.
familiarityExpression.low: Stays polite but reserved, even with people they have met before.

conflictResponse.high: Gets tense and shows it, but calms down if the other person apologizes.
conflictResponse.middle: Says plainly what bothered them and moves on.
conflictResponse.low: Stays calm and tries to settle things quickly.

STAFF: Keeps their private life to themselves with customers they do not know well.
PASSERBY: Shares light, everyday things about themselves but not private matters.
